charts.name: Avg response time per turn
charts.description: Average wall-clock time from user question to final answer, per turn.
charts.query: AVG of span duration where name starts with 'iteration-'

charts.name: Token usage & cost per model
charts.description: Total tokens and cost grouped by model (Hy3).
charts.query: SUM of usage details from LLM generations grouped by model

charts.name: Tool call counts per turn
charts.description: How many tool calls (search_papers, fetch_arxiv, rewrite_query) per turn.
charts.query: COUNT observations where name starts with 'tool:'

charts.name: Relevance distribution (LLM-judge)
charts.description: Distribution of LLM-as-judge relevance scores (RELEVANT/PARTLY/NON) from eval runs.

charts.name: User feedback ratio over time
charts.description: Ratio of thumbs-up to thumbs-down over time.

charts.name: Hybrid-search rerank win-rate
charts.description: Number of times cross-encoder reranking changed the top-1 result compared to raw hybrid fusion.
charts.query: COUNT observations where name='tool:search_papers' and metadata.mode='hybrid_rerank' / COUNT observations where metadata.mode='hybrid'
